restrictions.title: Not eligible by age
restrictions.explanation: The patient is outside the specialty's age window: paediatrics up to the 14th birthday, general practice and gynaecology from it.

restrictions.title: Referral required
restrictions.explanation: Dermatology and physiotherapy need a GP referral on file, and this patient has none for that specialty.

restrictions.title: Provider not in network
restrictions.explanation: The provider does not take this plan. Another provider in the same specialty may.

restrictions.title: Specialty not covered
restrictions.explanation: The plan covers nothing in this specialty, at any site.

restrictions.title: Location not covered
restrictions.explanation: The plan covers the specialty, but not at this site.

restrictions.title: Insurer referral required
restrictions.explanation: The insurer demands a referral for this specialty even where the clinic does not, so the same appointment is bookable for one patient and not another.

restrictions.title: Allowance exhausted
restrictions.explanation: The plan covers this specialty, but the patient has spent their visits for the year.

restrictions.title: Provider on leave
restrictions.explanation: The provider is away for the requested day.

restrictions.title: Location hours
restrictions.explanation: The provider is not at that site at the requested time.

restrictions.title: Type not offered
restrictions.explanation: The provider does not perform that appointment type.

restrictions.title: Patient history
restrictions.explanation: The type follows the record: a first visit is only for a patient the clinic has never seen, a review only for one it has.

appointment_types.name: First Visit
appointment_types.guidance: Any specialty with no first visit of its own — general practice, and gynaecology, which carries only its own review. Correct when the record says the clinic has never seen this patient, whatever they ask for on the call.

appointment_types.name: Review
appointment_types.guidance: The follow-up for general practice, and for any specialty with no review of its own. Correct when the record says the patient has been seen before. Not interchangeable with `dermatology_review` or `orthopaedic_review`, which run the same length under a different id.

appointment_types.name: Paediatric First Visit
appointment_types.guidance: A patient under 14 the clinic has never seen. Paediatrics carries its own pair, so `first_visit` is never right here.

appointment_types.name: Paediatric Review
appointment_types.guidance: A patient under 14 who has been seen before. Half an hour, not the quarter a general review takes — a child's follow-up is longer.

appointment_types.name: Gynaecology Review
appointment_types.guidance: A gynaecology follow-up. The one specialty with a review of its own and no first visit of its own, so a new gynaecology patient books the universal `first_visit` instead.

appointment_types.name: Physiotherapy Assessment
appointment_types.guidance: A new physiotherapy patient. Forty-five minutes, because the plan of treatment is set in the same appointment.

appointment_types.name: Physiotherapy Session
appointment_types.guidance: A physiotherapy patient already under treatment. Half an hour of treatment rather than a short check.

appointment_types.name: Dermatology First Visit
appointment_types.guidance: A dermatology patient the clinic has never seen. The referral is a separate rule — this is the type, not the permission.

appointment_types.name: Dermatology Review
appointment_types.guidance: A dermatology follow-up. Same fifteen minutes as `review`, different id: the specialty does not offer `review`, so booking it here fails the case on a slot that was otherwise right.

appointment_types.name: Orthopaedic First Visit
appointment_types.guidance: A new orthopaedics patient. The longest in the catalog: imaging is reviewed in the same appointment, so it needs three consecutive cells and often will not fit a gap a review would have.

appointment_types.name: Orthopaedic Review
appointment_types.guidance: An orthopaedics follow-up. Fifteen minutes like `review`, and again a different id — the specialty offers this one only.
